notice: This registry describes source organizations and databases; listing is not a guarantee that an individual claim or article is correct. Research citations are discovery leads and can be limited, retracted, contradicted, or inapplicable. Health citation search uses Europe PMC at request time (including PubMed records), a corpus of tens of millions, rather than copying all records into this extension. International ClaimReview ratings are imported from Google Data Commons and linked to the publisher articles; the feed is updated regularly and its metadata license is CC BY.

tiers.fact_check: Publishes verdicts on specific claims as its primary work.
tiers.official: Primary record holder: the body that produces the figure or the document.
tiers.news: General reporting. Useful for what was said and when, weaker as a verdict.
tiers.international: Non-Mongolian reference used when a claim travels across languages.
tiers.research: Biomedical research citation or literature database. A paper is evidence to assess, not a verdict or automatically reliable.

sources.name: FACTCHECK.mn
sources.note: Describes itself as Mongolia's first independent, professional, non-profit fact-checking newsroom. Its posts frequently check claims that circulated on Facebook, which is the case this project is built for.

sources.name: Mongolian Fact Checking Center (MFCC)
sources.note: Dedicated Mongolian fact-checking center. It publishes a fact-checking code, correction and appeal policies, and identifies itself as an IFCN signatory and Meta third-party fact-checking partner. Its published ratings remain the center's own assessment; inspect the article and cited evidence.

sources.name: Үндэсний статистикийн хороо (National Statistics Office)
sources.note: The body that publishes Mongolia's official statistics. Use it for any claim about a national figure rather than a news restatement of one.

sources.name: 1212.mn statistical database
sources.note: NSO's statistics database. DNS resolves but an HTTPS request from this machine timed out on 2026-10-26, so treat reachability as unconfirmed.

sources.name: Legalinfo.mn
sources.note: Official text of Mongolian legislation. Settles claims about what a law actually says.

sources.name: MONTSAME
sources.note: State-owned news agency, founded 1921. Reporters Without Borders describes its coverage as pro-government, so it is a record of the official position rather than an independent check of it. Returned HTTP 403 to a plain request on 2026-10-26.

sources.name: iKon.mn
sources.note: General Mongolian news. Useful for establishing what was reported and when.

sources.name: News.mn
sources.note: General Mongolian news. /feed answered 200 but not with XML on 2026-10-26.

sources.name: Gogo.mn
sources.note: General Mongolian news. No RSS feed found at the usual paths on 2026-10-26.

sources.name: Өнөөдөр
sources.note: Daily newspaper.

sources.name: World Health Organization
sources.note: Primary source for health claims that cross languages, such as the vaccine claims that recur on Mongolian Facebook.

sources.name: Reuters Fact Check
sources.note: International wire fact-checks. Often covers a claim before it is translated into Mongolian.

sources.name: AFP Fact Check
sources.note: Covers Asia-Pacific claims, including at least one widely shared claim about a Mongolian official.

sources.name: Snopes
sources.note: Long-running English-language fact-checker.

sources.name: Full Fact
sources.note: UK fact-checking charity.

sources.name: PubMed
sources.note: Searchable biomedical citation database maintained by the US National Library of Medicine. Records vary in study quality; check publication type and corrections.

sources.name: Europe PMC
sources.note: Biomedical and life-sciences literature database with an API used for live claim-related citation search. Includes records from multiple sources; a citation is not a quality endorsement.

sources.name: PubMed Central
sources.note: Full-text archive for biomedical and life-sciences literature. Availability in the archive does not itself mean a paper is high quality or current.

sources.name: MedlinePlus
sources.note: Patient-facing health information from the US National Library of Medicine. Useful for reviewed health-topic explainers; not a substitute for a clinician or an original clinical guideline.

sources.name: US National Institutes of Health
sources.note: US biomedical research and health information agency. Follow through to the specific institute, study, or guidance and check its date.

sources.name: US Centers for Disease Control and Prevention
sources.note: US public-health agency. Guidance is jurisdiction- and date-specific; compare with WHO and relevant local health authorities.

sources.name: US Food and Drug Administration
sources.note: US regulator for medicines, vaccines, food, devices, and related products. Regulatory status may differ by country.

sources.name: ClinicalTrials.gov
sources.note: US-hosted clinical-trial registry. A registered or completed trial is not proof that an intervention works; examine results and study status.

sources.name: NIH National Center for Complementary and Integrative Health
sources.note: NIH center reviewing evidence and safety for complementary health approaches.

sources.name: US National Cancer Institute
sources.note: NIH cancer institute with patient and research information; check the page date and distinguish guidance from active research.

sources.name: European Centre for Disease Prevention and Control
sources.note: EU agency for communicable-disease surveillance and guidance, principally for the European context.

sources.name: European Medicines Agency
sources.note: EU medicines regulator. Authorization and safety information is specific to EU regulatory decisions.

sources.name: NHS health information
sources.note: UK public health service patient information. Care pathways and eligibility reflect UK practice.

sources.name: NICE guidelines
sources.note: UK health and care guidance and evidence reviews. Recommendations are jurisdiction-specific and should be read with publication and update dates.

sources.name: Cochrane
sources.note: Publishes systematic reviews of health evidence. Review methods and certainty ratings matter; findings can change as new evidence appears.

sources.name: Health Canada
sources.note: Canadian federal health regulator and public-health information. Regulatory decisions and guidance are country-specific.

sources.name: Australian Department of Health, Disability and Ageing
sources.note: Australian national health department. Use as a primary source for Australian policy and health guidance.

sources.name: Therapeutic Goods Administration Australia
sources.note: Australian regulator for therapeutic goods; its approvals and safety notices may differ from other jurisdictions.

sources.name: Healthdirect Australia
sources.note: Australian government-funded consumer health information and service navigation.

sources.name: NHS inform Scotland
sources.note: Scotland public health service patient information; guidance is Scotland-specific.

sources.name: UK Government health publications
sources.note: UK government health policy, public-health notices, and official publications. Source entry matches the broad gov.uk domain; confirm that the specific page is an official health publication.

sources.name: Mayo Clinic
sources.note: Clinician-reviewed patient health information from a US nonprofit medical center; secondary reference, not a public regulator.

sources.name: Cleveland Clinic
sources.note: Patient health explainers from a US academic medical center; secondary reference, not an independent fact-check.

sources.name: Merck Manuals
sources.note: Clinician-authored medical reference with editorial review. Check version/date and use primary evidence for contested claims.

sources.name: Johns Hopkins Medicine
sources.note: Medical center patient and research information; secondary reference, not a regulator.

sources.name: Korea Disease Control and Prevention Agency
sources.note: South Korean public-health authority. Source language and national context may limit direct applicability.

sources.name: Singapore Ministry of Health
sources.note: Singapore health ministry information and policy; jurisdiction-specific.

sources.name: New Zealand Ministry of Health
sources.note: New Zealand health ministry guidance and public-health information; jurisdiction-specific.

sources.name: Japan Ministry of Health, Labour and Welfare
sources.note: Japanese national health authority; source material may require translation and applies to Japanese policy.

sources.name: WHO IRIS
sources.note: WHO institutional repository for reports and publications. Reports are not all clinical guidance; check document type and date.

sources.name: Монгол Улсын Эрүүл мэндийн яам
sources.note: Монгол Улсын эрүүл мэндийн бодлого, тушаал, статистик, сэрэмжлүүлгийн анхдагч эх сурвалж. Албан тушаал/зөвлөмжийн огноо, хүчинтэй эсэхийг шалга.

sources.name: Нийгмийн эрүүл мэндийн үндэсний төв
sources.note: Монголын нийгмийн эрүүл мэндийн судалгаа, тандалт, зөвлөмж гаргадаг үндэсний байгууллага. Тайлангийн аргачлал, огноог шалга.

sources.name: Халдварт өвчин судлалын үндэсний төв
sources.note: Монголын халдварт өвчин, тандалт, дархлаажуулалтын чиглэлийн үндэсний мэргэшсэн төв. Шуурхай зөвлөгөөний огноог шалга.

sources.name: Зоонозын өвчин судлалын үндэсний төв
sources.note: Монголын зоонозын өвчний тандалт, мэргэжлийн мэдээллийн үндэсний төв.

sources.name: Хавдар судлалын үндэсний төв
sources.note: Монголын үндэсний лавлагаа шатлалын хавдрын төв. Өвчтөнд зориулсан материал болон судалгааг эмчилгээний албан ёсны удирдамжаас ялгаж унш.

sources.name: Эх хүүхдийн эрүүл мэндийн үндэсний төв
sources.note: Эх, хүүхдийн төрөлжсөн тусламж болон эрүүл мэндийн боловсролын үндэсний төв.

sources.name: Эрүүл мэндийн хөгжлийн төв
sources.note: Эрүүл мэндийн салбарын мэдээлэл, статистик, хүний нөөц, хөгжилтэй холбоотой төрийн байгууллага.

sources.name: Эм, эмнэлгийн хэрэгслийн хяналт, зохицуулалтын нэгдсэн систем
sources.note: Монголд бүртгэлтэй эм, эмнэлгийн хэрэгсэл, нэмэлт бүтээгдэхүүний улсын бүртгэл ба зохицуулалтын мэдээлэл. Бүртгэлтэй байх нь тухайн эм танд тохирно гэсэн эмчилгээний зөвлөгөө биш.

sources.name: Монгол Улсын эм, эмнэлгийн хэрэгслийн зохицуулалтын газар
sources.note: Эм, эмнэлгийн хэрэгслийн зохицуулалтын байгууллагын албан эх сурвалж; бүтээгдэхүүний бүртгэл, зохицуулалтын мэдээг эх баримтаар нягтал.

sources.name: Эрүүл мэндийн даатгалын ерөнхий газар
sources.note: Эрүүл мэндийн даатгал, санхүүжилт, гэрээт байгууллагын талаарх анхдагч төрийн мэдээлэл; эмнэлзүйн үр нөлөөг дангаар тогтоохгүй.

sources.name: Нийслэлийн Эрүүл мэндийн газар
sources.note: Улаанбаатар хотын тусгай зөвшөөрөл, эрүүл мэндийн үйлчилгээний орон нутгийн мэдээлэл.

sources.name: Улсын Нэгдүгээр Төв Эмнэлэг
sources.note: Монголын лавлагаа шатлалын улсын эмнэлэг; өвчтөний мэдээлэл болон эмнэлгийн мэдээг эх сурвалж болгон ашиглаж, эмчилгээний үр нөлөөг тусдаа клиник судалгаагаар шалга.

sources.name: Улсын Хоёрдугаар Төв Эмнэлэг
sources.note: Монголын улсын төв эмнэлэг; өөрийн үйлчилгээ, мэдээ, эмнэлзүйн ажлын мэдээллийн анхдагч эх сурвалж.

sources.name: Улсын Гуравдугаар Төв Эмнэлэг
sources.note: Монголын зүрх судасны чиглэлийн улсын төв эмнэлэг; байгууллагын мэдээ нь бие даасан үнэлгээ биш.

sources.name: Гэмтэл согог судлалын үндэсний төв
sources.note: Монголын улсын гэмтэл, согогийн лавлагаа төв; үйлчилгээ болон байгууллагын мэдээлэлд эх сурвалжлана.

sources.name: Арьсны өвчин судлалын үндэсний төв
sources.note: Монголын улсын арьс, харшлын өвчний лавлагаа төв; зөвлөмжийн огноо, зориулалтыг шалга.

sources.name: Google Fact Check Data Feed / Data Commons
sources.note: Public structured ClaimReview metadata feed with publisher, claim, rating, date, and original article link. Structured compilation is CC BY; it does not contain the article itself. Ratings stay attributed to each publisher and are not combined into TAYO verdicts. The local SQLite index is refreshed with scripts/refresh_claimreview.py.
